tasks.title: One /bs use resolver over clone and overlay roadmaps
tasks.summary: sessionBinding.ts learns overlay-declared projects and path arguments in one resolver; the M4 helpers move there.
tasks.objective: Give sessionBinding.ts one resolver for `/bs use` that both call sites can share. Move `overlayRoadmapAt`, `declaredAs` and the `realOr` they need out of promptCapture.ts into sessionBinding.ts as exports, and make rule M4 import them (no behaviour change to M4). Add `knownProjectRefs(input)` returning `{ name, dir }` for today's `factoryProjects` list plus each directory directly under the same two roots (entries sorted) whose own overlay roadmap declares it by the M4 dir-match rule, counting a name only when it is one plain path segment equal to the root entry's name (deduped by `normalizeProjectName`, clone spelling and directory win; the context repoRoot and any `isFactoryCheckout` directory are not scanned). `knownProjectNames(input)` keeps its signature and returns those names. Add `resolveUseProject(arg: string | null, input) -> { known: string[]; matched: string | undefined }`: a bare name matches through `matchProject` as today; an argument that contains `/` or starts with `.` or `~` is a path, resolved against `env.HOME` for `~`/`~/...` (only when HOME is a non-empty absolute path) and the input cwd otherwise, realpath'd (raw on failure), and matched to the known entry whose directory realpaths to it. TDD: write the epic criterion 1 test in factory/orchestrator/test/sessionBinding.test.ts first, watch it fail at the base sha (`project-b` missing from the list), then implement. This task runs beside task-3, which widens the names scan: every literal in this task's files must pass sessionBindingNames.test.ts as it stands at the base sha (see the names-scan clause). Read factory/specs/active/bs-use-2/epic-spec.md before starting; it is the contract this task's criteria cite.
acceptance_criteria: Epic criterion 1, in factory/orchestrator/test/sessionBinding.test.ts `describe('knownProjectNames')`: temp tree with clone `base/clone` (has `.git`), a clone roadmap declaring no other project, and `base/project-b/.blacksmith/factory/specs/roadmap.md` declaring `project-b` and `project-a` while `base/project-a` exists with no overlay. At the base sha the list lacks `project-b` (the test fails on that assertion); after the change it holds every name it held before plus `project-b`, and not `project-a`.

Epic criterion 2, same file, one `it` per case: (a) a name declared in both the clone roadmap and its checkout's own overlay appears once, clone spelling; (b) a directory named by the imported LEGACY_FACTORY_PROJECT whose overlay declares that spelling adds nothing (FACTORY_PROJECT_NAME exactly once, the legacy spelling never); (c) the context repoRoot carrying its own overlay roadmap adds nothing; (d) a missing root, a plain file under a root, a directory with no overlay, an unparseable overlay, and an overlay declaring only other projects add nothing and do not throw; (e) a symlink `base/project-b` to an overlay checkout outside the roots makes `project-b` known exactly once; (f) plain segment: `base/project-b` whose overlay declares only `./project-b`, `project-b/../project-b` and `project-b/` adds nothing, and `resolveUseProject('../project-b', ...)` gives `matched` undefined there; (g) out of scope pinned: `base/dir-x` whose overlay declares only `project-a`, once with `base/project-a` absent and once with it present without an overlay, adds neither `dir-x` nor `project-a`, and `resolveUseProject` gives `matched` undefined for `'dir-x'` and `'../dir-x'`; (h) order: overlay checkouts `project-b` then `project-a` created in that order list `project-a` before `project-b`. For (f), if `factoryProjects` already drops a spelling, the hand-back names it and the mutation proof (remove the plain-segment check, watch (f) fail by name, restore) uses a spelling it keeps.

Epic criterion 3, same file, `describe('resolveUseProject')`: `matched` is `project-b` for `../project-b` with cwd `base/clone`, for the absolute path, for `~/project-b` with `env.HOME` = base, for `../project-b/` (trailing slash), and for both the symlink and its target; `matched` is FACTORY_PROJECT_NAME for the absolute path of the imported REPO_ROOT; `matched` is undefined for an existing unknown directory, a non-existent path, `~/project-b` with HOME absent from env, `~/../project-b` with HOME `''`, and `~/project-b` with HOME `'..'` (cwd `base/clone` in each; a cwd-anchored fallback would resolve the last two to `base/project-b` and return `project-b`, so these rows fail on that bug and pass only when HOME is required to be non-empty and absolute); a bare name gives the same `matched` as `matchProject(name, known)`; `known` deep-equals `knownProjectNames(input)`; `arg` null gives `matched` undefined.

Epic criterion 6 (helpers and hook-light half): promptCapture.ts no longer defines `overlayRoadmapAt` or `declaredAs` and imports both from `./sessionBinding.js`; every existing M4 test passes unchanged; a source-scan `it` in sessionBinding.test.ts reads src/sessionBinding.ts, collects every `from '...'` and `import('...')` specifier, and fails naming the specifier if any resolves to a `db`, `cli`, `usage`, `promptCapture` or `bindingReminder` module. Mutation proof in the hand-back: add `import './promptCapture.js';` to sessionBinding.ts, watch the scan fail by name, revert.

Epic criterion 9: Gate, run from the repo root on the task's own tree and read to the end of each output: `pnpm run test` (the full root suite, about 200 s; never a scoped vitest run), `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run typecheck:test`, `pnpm biome check .`. All four green before hand-back.

functional_clauses: Known projects = `factoryProjects({ roadmapPath, roots })` for the context roadmap, then, for each root in order and each entry of `readdirSync(root).sort()` (default code-unit order, so macOS and Linux agree), the name `declaredAs(dir, overlayRoadmapAt(dir), roots)` gives when `existsSync(overlayRoadmapAt(dir))`; only that directory's own name is taken, never another bullet of its overlay.

Plain segment: an overlay-derived name counts only when it contains no `/` or `\`, is not `.` or `..`, and equals the root entry's name (the directory name under the root, before realpath); anything else contributes nothing, so no path-like string reaches the known list, the reminder line or a recorded binding.
An overlay-derived name is dropped when `normalizeProjectName` of it equals that of a name already in the list; the earlier entry's spelling and directory are kept.
A root entry whose realpath equals the realpath of the input repoRoot, or for which `isFactoryCheckout` is true, is skipped before its overlay is read.

Path test: an argument is a path exactly when it contains `/` or starts with `.` or `~`. `~` alone and `~/rest` resolve against `input.env.HOME` only when HOME is a non-empty absolute path; absent, empty or relative HOME, and `~user/...`, match nothing; every other path resolves with `path.resolve(input.cwd, arg)`.
A path matches the first known entry whose `realOr(dir)` equals `realOr(resolved)`; the result is that entry's name, never the path.
`knownProjectNames` keeps its exported signature, still returns [] when anything throws, and returns exactly the names of `knownProjectRefs` in order.
Rule M4 in `resolveCaptureStore` is behaviourally unchanged: same roots, same order (context roadmap, then the cwd checkout's overlay), same result.
nonfunctional_clauses: Never throws: a missing or unreadable root, entry or overlay contributes nothing; each root's scan is wrapped so one bad root does not hide the others.

Hook-light: sessionBinding.ts adds only `node:fs`/`node:path` and existing light-module imports; no import of db, cli, usage, promptCapture or bindingReminder (no new import cycle); the criterion 6 source scan enforces it.
Performance: the root scan runs only inside `knownProjectRefs`/`resolveUseProject`; nothing in this task calls them from a path every prompt takes.

No real project name anywhere in code, tests, comments or docs: placeholders only (`project-a`, `project-b`, `<project>`, `nothing-here`; `dir-x` only as a directory name or resolver argument). `project-c` is not used. The factory's own name and its legacy spelling are imported from `projectName.ts` (`FACTORY_PROJECT_NAME`, `LEGACY_FACTORY_PROJECT`), never typed.

Names scan as it stands (this task runs beside task-3): every literal in the three claimed files passes factory/orchestrator/test/sessionBindingNames.test.ts at the base sha. So: no `/bs use` text followed by a path anywhere, in tests or comments (tests call `resolveUseProject` with the bare argument, `'../project-b'`); no `/bs use` argument or quoted `project:` value outside today's sets; fixture roadmaps write bullets through an interpolated `- project: ${name}` template (the scan skips `$` values), and `dir-x`, `./project-b` and similar appear only as directory names, array entries or resolver arguments.
Claims: edit only the three claimed files; existing exports of sessionBinding.ts and promptCapture.ts keep their declarations (keeps_exports).

Gate, run from the repo root on the task's own tree and read to the end of each output: `pnpm run test` (the full root suite, about 200 s; never a scoped vitest run), `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run typecheck:test`, `pnpm biome check .`. All four green before hand-back.

tasks.title: Binding write and reply share the resolver
tasks.summary: promptCapture and bindingReminder decide /bs use through resolveUseProject, so an overlay name or a path binds and the reply agrees.
tasks.objective: Switch both `/bs use` call sites to task-1's `resolveUseProject`: the binding write in factory/orchestrator/src/promptCapture.ts (today `parseUseCommand` -> `matchProject(useName, knownProjectNames({...ctx, cwd}))`) and the reply in factory/orchestrator/src/bindingReminder.ts (today `knownProjectNames` -> `matchProject` -> unknown / not-recorded / standing lines). Each site calls the resolver only after `parseUseCommand` returned non-null, passing the same `{ repoRoot, cwd, env, isClone, roadmapPath }` it passes today; the reminder uses `known` for `unknownProjectLines` and `matched` for its branch. TDD: write the epic criterion 4 test in factory/orchestrator/test/promptCaptureBinding.test.ts first and watch it fail on the tree with task-1 and task-3 merged (no `session-bound` for `/bs use project-b`). acceptance_criteria: Epic criterion 4, in factory/orchestrator/test/promptCaptureBinding.test.ts: in a temp clone-shaped store whose clone roadmap declares no other project, with `base/project-b` carrying an overlay roadmap that declares `project-b` and `project-a` (`base/project-a` exists, no overlay), `capturePrompt` on `/bs use project-b`, `/bs use ../project-b`, the absolute path (built with `path.join`, never typed after `/bs use`), and `/bs use ~/project-b` with ctx env HOME = base each leaves exactly one new `session-bound` event with `payload.project` = `project-b` (fresh cli id per prompt). One table-driven test runs capture then reply per prompt and asserts `session-bound written` equals `reply has no unknown-name line` for every row.
